rules.statement: An official document the existence of which was not known to a party during the trial may be admitted in appeal.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 10 of Ordinance No. 4 of 1870 gives a final and conclusive effect to the findings of the Commissioner appointed under that Ordinance to inquire. The record of these findings is to be found in the documents P 1 and D 1, which are really one."
